summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration efforts with Spark, including variant support and API upgrades. Additionally, planning for the upcoming Iceberg 1.12.0 release is underway, alongside proposals for enhancing transaction isolation and refining the REST specification.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes
Planning for Apache Iceberg 1.12.0 release has begun
Discussion on enhancing transaction isolation with a batch LoadTables API
Concerns raised about the complexity of the X-Iceberg-Client-Capabilities header in the REST spec
